CREATE TABLE learning_reviews (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), outcome_revision_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES outcome_revisions(id), outcome_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, decision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, reviewed_by_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_learning_review_revision UNIQUE (outcome_revision_id))
CREATE TRIGGER learning_reviews_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON learning_reviews BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Learning review history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER learning_reviews_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON learning_reviews BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Learning review history is immutable'); END
